g1.label: 1. Lost their ___
g1.why: Fires destroyed the places where animals live, so they lost their homes.

g2.label: 2. When the ocean gets too ___
g2.why: The text says coral turns white and can die when the ocean gets too warm.

g3.label: 3. A farmer ___ 24 rabbits
g3.why: To release an animal means to let it go free in nature.

g4.label: 4. They eat the ___
g4.why: Rabbits eat plants; you can't eat 'planets' or 'plans'.

g5.label: 5. Beetles on sugar cane ___
g5.why: Sugar cane grows on farms, and the beetles were eating it there.

g6.label: 6. Their skin is ___
g6.why: Poisonous means it can make you very ill or kill you, so the snakes die.

g1.label: 1. Droughts are rare in Australia
g1.why: The text says droughts are common in Australia.

g2.label: 2. Bushfires spread fast when the land is hot and dry
g2.why: The text says fires start easily and spread fast when the land is hot and dry.

g3.label: 3. The Black Summer fires burned in the north-west
g3.why: The Black Summer fires burned across the south-east, not the north-west.

g4.label: 4. Coral can die when the ocean is too warm
g4.why: The text says the coral turns white and can die when the ocean gets too warm.

g5.label: 5. The farmer brought the rabbits from England
g5.why: The text says a farmer released 24 rabbits, but not where they came from.

g6.label: 6. The cane toads solved the beetle problem
g6.why: The toads didn't eat the beetles, so they didn't solve the problem.

g1.correct: a long time with little or no rain
accept: a long time with little or no rain
g1.label: 1. A drought is ___
g1.why: A drought is a long period with little or no rain.

g2.correct: a fire that burns trees and land
accept: a fire that burns trees and land
g2.label: 2. A bushfire is ___
g2.why: A bushfire burns trees and land in the countryside, often in hot, dry weather.

g3.correct: animals or plants that come from other places and cause problems
accept: animals or plants that come from other places and cause problems
g3.label: 3. Invasive species are ___
g3.why: Invasive species come from other places and cause problems, like rabbits and cane toads.

g4.label: 4. To release an animal means ___
g4.why: To release means to let go free, like the farmer did with the rabbits.

g5.label: 5. Coral is made by ___
g5.why: The text says the reef is built by tiny sea animals called coral.

g6.correct: can make you very ill or kill you
accept: can make you very ill or kill you
g6.label: 6. Something poisonous ___
g6.why: Poisonous means it can make you very ill or kill you.

g7.label: 7. 24 rabbits ___ into the wild
g7.why: Remember 'Canada': past passive with a plural subject is were + past participle.

g8.label: 8. If we ___ the reef
g8.why: Remember 'Healthy living': if + simple present, then will in the main clause.
